subject: general
question: A and B can do a work in 15 days and 30 days, respectively. They start working together, but A leaves after 3 days. How much time will B take to complete the remaining work?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do the work in 15 days.

B can do the work in 30 days.

A leaves after 3 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/15

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/30

Work done = Work rate × Time

**Calculation:**

Work done by A and B in 3 days = 3 × (1/15 + 1/30)
